uniform_interpretation: For each matched control to be eligible, its fixed-slate complete-view AUC must be at most the corresponding unprotected within-track anchor AUC + 0.010 for each recipient in EACH paired source seed, inclusive. Task point utility remains checked against U0 and Ucal for both tasks in each seed. Rank eligible controls by minimum paired-seed mean coalition AUC with frozen tie breaks.
